text_block_list.text: Thanks to the Mejiro family's cooperation, Dream Journey's summer training camp went smoothly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"—It appears the items prepared on our end
are being used without any issues as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, I shall return to my own training.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I am truly grateful for your generous cooperation.
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. This is merely
my duty as a member of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The results have yet to come.
Please continue to apply yourself diligently—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, whoa, whoa!
What are you workin' hard on?!
The ones who suddenly appeared were Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa... Both of them are Umamusume who haven't debuted yet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
A-And out they come!
The rowdy ruffians of summer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The two of you are wreaking havoc on the training camp!
Challenging people to races left and right...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I was put through a terrible ordeal just the other day myself..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, just remembering it gives me
such bittersweet feelings!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Journey, I can see it, you know.
Right behind your eyes—the madness!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You've got it, don't you?! That shiny thing...!
Gimme, give me that thrill!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san, please escape!
I will hold them back here...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern.
However, I would be delighted to take you on.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure if it will be to your liking, but...
I will do my best to ensure you enjoy it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Journey-san...
As always, you are far too kind...!
And so, a spontaneous match? was decided to be held—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do this!
Sexy! Eats! Dynamite!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: In short, it's a shaved ice speed-eating contest.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: It's an explosion where you can see right through it. So that means it fits, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well then, pops at the beach hut!
Gimme the "secret" menu, if ya please!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Super Sweet Denbu Flavor," "Ultra Pungent Kusaya Durian Flavor,"
"Devilishly Bitter Goya Flavor," "Rock-Hard Shaved Ice"...
choice_data_list: I don't even know what's what anymore...

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Pretty aggressive, aren't they...?
Not bad.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I'm going with "Super Sweet Denbu Flavor."
It's precisely because I don't like it that it fires me up!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll take "Ultra-Strong Kusaya Durian Flavor"!
Has a nice ring to it, don'tcha think?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Then, since I have the chance...
shall I choose from the remaining two?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
which one do you think is good?

To be honest, I can't imagine how any of them taste, but...
if I have to choose between the two—
choice_data_list: The 'Hard Ice' that looks like it'll boost your power
The "Demon-Bitter Goya Flavor" that looks like it takes some serious guts

text_block_list.text:
Keeping training in mind, since I had the choice,
I picked the one that seemed more likely to build up my power.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Looks like we have no choice but to check and see.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then... I'll leave
the shaved ice order to you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gaaahhh! It stinks so bad!!!
Is this a nose-melting stage!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...It's cold.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Gwaaaaah!! I lost!!!!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
To think you'd finish off that shaved ice so fast...!
You win this one, Journey!

...I didn't quite understand what just happened,
but Dream Journey won. I thought for sure
she'd be bewildered, but—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: I see. Eating chilled iron balls without syrup at high speed... So that's how you interpreted it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Golshi-san.
Your ideas are always intriguing."
Even after that, Dream Journey engaged in a few... contests? with Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa, and then—
"I just have this impression that Dream Journey can handle bitter tastes well. It should be much better than that mysterious 'hard ice.'"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Well then,
shall we do that?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Guhhhh...!!!
S-S-Sweet...!!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I'm gonna choke on sugar...!
Damn it, where's Journey...?!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
!?
This guy... acting like it's nothing—

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Journey.
That shaved ice... you put something in it, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
No, no, surely not...
Would you like to check?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't show on my face very much...
Here, please neutralize the taste with something sweet.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, open your mouth...
...That's it, swallow slowly.
Even after that, Dream Journey engaged in a few... contests? with Gold Ship and Nakayama Festa, and then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whew, that was so much fun!
All right, let's go find our next summer adventure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Jordan spotted!
Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Take care.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please...
feel free to visit anytime again.
"Could it be that she just wanted to hang out with those two...? The thought crossed my mind, but... the truth remains shrouded in mystery."
